rules.title: DFARS specialty metals restriction (252.225-7009)
rules.summary: Certain specialty metals in articles delivered to DoD must be melted or produced in the U.S. or a qualifying country.
rules.why_it_matters: Metal parts need mill-origin evidence, not only supplier country.
rules.workaround: Require melt-origin certificates on every metal PO.

rules.title: DFARS counterfeit electronic parts rules (252.246-7007, -7008)
rules.summary: Contractors must run a counterfeit-detection system and buy electronic parts from original manufacturers or authorized sources where required.
rules.why_it_matters: Spend with distributors on electronic parts carries extra proof duties.
rules.workaround: Flag distributor lines for electronic parts and keep traceability records.

rules.title: Section 232 investigation: commercial aircraft and jet engines
rules.summary: Investigation into imports of commercial aircraft, jet engines and parts.
rules.why_it_matters: Could add tariffs on imported aerospace parts.
